svg.title: Multi-omic analysis pipeline for head and neck adenoid cystic carcinoma
svg.desc: Patient tumours are profiled by bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics; candidate genes from all three are filtered by hierarchical Bayesian shrinkage into a locked four-gene panel (DSCAM, ODC1, NCAPG, CCNB2), validated in three external cohorts.
svg.text: From tumour tissue to a four-gene prognostic panel
Head & neck adenoid cystic carcinoma · poor (< 2 y) vs favourable (> 5 y) survival · numbered stages match the repository folders
Illustrative schematic — glyphs are stylised, not data. Statistics as reported in the manuscript.
